change.what: New status page that lists every project and shows how fresh each status is.
change.why: UC-01 needs a single page with a freshness label; the old app only had a per-project view.

change.what: Adds a status timestamp and an append-only status history table.
change.why: Freshness needs a timestamp, and keeping history replaces the manual spreadsheet record.

change.what: Status updates now flow as events instead of waiting for the weekly batch.
change.why: UC-02 must reach every viewer in under 10 seconds, which a batch cannot do.

change.what: The weekly spreadsheet-to-email job is switched off.
change.why: The Aggregator builds the weekly report from status history, so the cron job has nothing left to do.

change.what: A worker that reads status events, writes the latest status and history, and builds the weekly report.
change.why: Something has to turn events into stored status and the weekly report once the cron job is gone.
